body:
hey, that WAS a real tournament, and just because it took place yesterday (wednesday) doesn’t mean jack sh1t.  alot of the kids around here have spring break from their high school, so one of the TD’s who happens to be a teacher decided to run a wednesday tournament.  that one is totally legit, and if you don’t think so, then check out the "tournaments" section on decipher.com.



blah
title: Geoff's Epilogue to Last Tourney
author: Geoff Snider
event_desc: a Wednesday tournament for local high-school players on spring break, run by a tournament director who is a teacher (city not stated)
summary: A short note by Geoff Snider defending his report [[Geoff Snider March 2001 Illinois tournament (28 March) report (tournament report)]]: the Wednesday event was a real, sanctioned tournament, run during the local high-school spring break by a tournament director who is a teacher and listed on decipher.com.
notes: Defence of the previous report (both posted 29 March 2001), not a game report; event = that report's event [[March 2001 Illinois tournament (28 March)]] (existing hub; its date already comes from this note). Snider won it (6–0, recorded from d1974), so author_played is true; no games or finish repeated here.
The related report's page title is withheld (crude slug), hence the link to 'Geoff Snider March 2001 Illinois tournament (28 March) report'.
